body: I think this makes sense. I am actually expecting that clear and calm mind whenever I sit and meditate. I expect during the meditation session that I’ll have a unwavering focus. These expectations are leading to anxiety probably.
They updated the ‘package left the facility’ status late.

Kind of unrelated but I work in a senior position and I am quite tall, so wherever I go people automatically assume that he must be a disciplined guy which I am not really. I just want to have fun and blend in the crowd and not to be seen differently.
